subject: Error: Species %in% recordTable[, speciesCol] is not TRUE

messages.author: 801722d43588a5ba
messages.subject: Error: Species %in% recordTable[, speciesCol] is not TRUE
parts:
Hey everyone,

Just wondering if anyone has come across this issue. I have been able to run camtrapR successfully in the past (many times) but I am getting this error on the set of code which worked fine 3 weeks ago. I usually use the record table generated by the package itself but I wanted to remove the accented characters from record table manually and read it back into R. I understand Jurgen has provided a way to remove accented characters from record table by setting additionalMetadataTags = "L" but I still don't understand why I am error now when it worked just fine few weeks ago. I have tried new and old versions of R and camtrapR package but the problem persists. 

Much appreciate the help!

messages.author: 801722d43588a5ba
messages.subject: Re: Error: Species %in% recordTable[, speciesCol] is not TRUE
parts: Just to add further, this only happens if we have accented character issue in Species Name and have corrected them either manually or using additionalMetadataTags = "L" at any stage otherwise no such error is obtained.
